name: Goofspiel
description: Imperfect-information Goofspiel: sealed simultaneous bids for prize cards turned up in a random order; players learn who won each prize but never the other bid. Returns are the point difference.

cards.description: Cards per hand and prize cards.

brief.situation: Two players each hold cards 1 to {$inputs.cards}. Prize cards 1 to {$inputs.cards} are turned up one at a time, in a random order.
brief.rules: For each prize both players bid one of their cards at the same time. The higher bid wins the prize's points; on a tie nobody does. Bid cards are spent. You learn who won each prize, never the other player's bid. Your score is your points minus your opponent's.

else.say: The bids tie; nobody wins prize {$world.prize}.

bid.description: Bid one of your cards for the prize.

table.show: Prize: {$world.prize}. Your cards: {$join($actor.hand, ' ')}. Points: you {$actor.points}, opponent {$other($actor).points}.
